scientific_integrity: Originality is asserted only for intrinsic recovery of excluded Galois centers, the converse point-configuration stabilizer, and uniqueness of a smooth invariant degree-d hypersurface. The exact quasi-Galois center set and Fermat symmetry group are published inputs.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero and d>=4, ambient dimension >=2. Only projective-linear stabilizers; finite-field checks do not substitute for infinite proof. Prior equivalence may survive in unindexed literature.
title: Quasi-Galois reflection centers determine the Fermat hypersurface
